## What it is

<!-- KEEP:what-it-is:START -->
Notifications: `NOTIF_TEMPLATE` (per tenant, bilingual subject and body with variables), `NOTIF_CHANNEL_CONFIG`
(EMAIL, IN_APP and any application channel, enabled per tenant), `NOTIF_LOG` (one row per channel per dispatch:
QUEUED → SENT | FAILED | SKIPPED_NO_PROVIDER, or REJECTED when a `requiredCategory` is not met — retried with exponential
backoff and a claim lease) and `NOTIF_INBOX`
(the in-app inbox of staff and customers). Dispatch is asynchronous, after the caller's commit, on the
tenant-propagating executor; a tenant's e-mails carry its sender name and Reply-To (CU settings). Since 1.6.0 every
template written carries a category (`UTILITY` | `MARKETING`, `TemplateCategory`); a dispatch may require one and is
refused (nothing sent, one `REJECTED` row) when the template's category differs or is unset. A dispatch may carry stored
FILE documents as attachments (`NOTIF_LOG_ATTACHMENT` records what was attached; a channel whose provider cannot carry
them has its row `FAILED` at dispatch; the e-mail carries them as multipart attachments) and may address a person without a
user account by e-mail (`recipientAddress`, EMAIL only).
<!-- KEEP:what-it-is:END -->

## When to use it

<!-- KEEP:when-to-use:START -->
Whenever a person must be told something: an approval, a due date, a status change. The module seeds its
templates (`V1000+`, `TENANT_ID = 1`), calls `NotificationDispatchApi.dispatch` with the template code, the
recipient (`SEC_USER` id) and plain-value variables, and reads the outcome from the events or
`NotificationLogQueryApi`. `dispatchIndependently` when the module's own writes must survive a failed dispatch.
A new channel (SMS, PUSH) is a `ChannelProvider` bean. A document the person must receive (a statement, an invoice) is
stored through FILE and named in `DispatchCommand.attachments`; a person without an account is named by
`recipientAddress`.
<!-- KEEP:when-to-use:END -->

## How to call it

<!-- KEEP:how-to-call:START -->
```java
// tell the approver, after this transaction commits (one NOTIF_LOG row per enabled channel)
notificationDispatchApi.dispatch(new DispatchCommand(
    order.getApproverUserId(), "SHOP_ORDER_SUBMITTED", null, "SHOP", order.getId(), "SHOP_ORDER",
    Map.of("orderNo", order.getOrderNo(), "total", order.getTotal().toPlainString())));

// a reminder that may only go out as a UTILITY template (1.6.0): MARKETING or unclassified → TEMPLATE_CATEGORY_MISMATCH /
// TEMPLATE_CATEGORY_UNSET, nothing sent, one REJECTED log row
notificationDispatchApi.dispatch(new DispatchCommand(tenantUserId, "LSE_RENT_DUE", List.of("SMS"), "LSE",
    lease.getId(), "LSE_LEASE", Map.of("dueDate", due), TemplateCategory.UTILITY));
Optional<TemplateCategory> category = notificationDispatchApi.getTemplateCategory("LSE_RENT_DUE");

// a statement as a PDF attachment (1.6.0): the document was stored through FilePrivateStoreApi in this tenant; limits
// notif.attachments.max-count / max-total-bytes (CU settings); IN_APP cannot carry it → that row is FAILED, the e-mail goes
notificationDispatchApi.dispatch(new DispatchCommand(ownerUserId, "OWN_STATEMENT_ISSUED", List.of("EMAIL", "IN_APP"), "OWN",
    statement.getId(), "OWN_STATEMENT", Map.of("period", period), null,
    List.of(new AttachmentRef(statement.getPdfDocumentId(), "Statement " + period + ".pdf"))));

// to a person without a user account (1.6.0): the address is the recipient, EMAIL only
notificationDispatchApi.dispatch(new DispatchCommand(null, "OWN_STATEMENT_ISSUED", List.of("EMAIL"), "OWN",
    statement.getId(), "OWN_STATEMENT", Map.of("period", period), null,
    List.of(new AttachmentRef(statement.getPdfDocumentId())), owner.getEmail()));

// did it go out? (dispatch is asynchronous)
List<DispatchLogRecord> logs = notificationLogQueryApi.findByRecipientModuleAndReference(approverId, "SHOP", "SHOP_ORDER");

// an SMS channel for this deployment
@Bean ChannelProvider smsChannelProvider(SmsGateway gateway) {
    return new ChannelProvider() {
        public String channel() { return "SMS"; }
        public DeliveryResult send(OutboundMessage m) { gateway.send(m, m.category()); return DeliveryResult.sent(); }
        // leave supportsAttachments() at its default (false) unless the gateway carries files: m.attachments() then holds the bytes
    };
}
```
<!-- KEEP:how-to-call:END -->
